name: fxshelf
description: fxshelf — a shelf of copy-friendly micro animation packages for React and Vue.
author: Lu Zhaotian

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fxshelf/card-orbit && npm run build -w @fxshelf/glyph-rain
scripts.lint: oxlint packages/card-orbit/src packages/glyph-rain/src apps/site/components apps/site/lib apps/site/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fxshelf/card-orbit && npm run typecheck -w @fxshelf/glyph-rain && npm run typecheck -w @fxshelf/site
scripts.pack:check: npm run pack:check -w @fxshelf/card-orbit && npm run pack:check -w @fxshelf/glyph-rain
